lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sub-parallel rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters forming a geometric grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, most prominent in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical columns of higher luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, creating defined grid-like anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient (high-luminance upper edge, shadowed lower edge), oriented longitudinally across the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column and near the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
